title: Experimental subdiffraction source discrimination enabled by spatial demultiplexing and single-photon detectors
summary: We experimentally demonstrate a universal, parameter-independent test for asymmetric source discrimination below the diffraction limit. The test exploits spatial-mode demultiplexing (SPADE) and single-photon detection to discriminate the presence of a faint source in the vicinity of a brighter one. We develop a complete theory of the test in the presence of arbitrary modal crosstalk and show that the crosstalk-affected test retains a favorable error exponent over diffraction-limited direct imaging, provided that the crosstalk remains below a threshold $C_{\mathrm{max}}\simeq 1/9$.
